title: 第一卷 第81章 修行许可证第一卷 第80章 神权已坠人道当尊
lines: “两月之后，便是世家考核大会。”
陈渊目光扫过全场众人，神色沉凝锐利，“我要你们趁这段时日潜心苦修，尽数突破境界，多一分实力，便多一分活命的底气。”
“与此同时，更要打磨自身修为本事。待到大会开启，便随我一同为陈家，争下更多修行资源和资格。”
众人望着陈渊，皆是心潮澎湃。
世间难得这般体恤下属的少主，还时时刻刻都在为他们的性命安危着想！
一时间，众人心中满是感念，不少人眼眶泛红。
“行了，不必这般作态，都各自回去闭关修行吧。”
陈渊淡淡一笑，摆了摆手示意众人退下，潜心修炼。
陈昭宁知晓陈渊即将闭关冲击黄庭境，不愿多加打扰，也随之翩然离去。
她暗中立下誓言，定要勤勉苦修，早日追上陈渊的脚步。
唯有糯米乖巧留在原地，不曾挪动半步。
陈渊轻声告知她，自己即将闭关修行，让她这段时日，暂且跟着陈昭宁作伴修行。
话音未落，陈擎苍便缓步走来，开口直言要亲自带糯米修炼。
“老爷子，您竟要亲自传授糯米修行之道？”
陈渊脸上满是惊喜。
有无高人指点修行，差距宛若天壤之别。
眼前这位老爷子底蕴深不可测，远非自己能比拟。
由他亲自教导糯米，自然比自己出手稳妥百倍。
陈擎苍转头看向糯米，眉眼间露出难得的温和笑意，
“她体内的邪神灵种已然生根发芽，我自会为她量身定制修行法门，助她彻底掌控异种本源力量，再为她寻两门契合自身体质的无上功法。”
“阿渊哥……”
糯米仰头望着陈渊，小脸上满是不舍。
陈渊蹲下身，柔声安抚道：
“乖乖跟着爷爷修行，只有糯米变得足够强大，日后才能真正帮到我、护得住我。”
听闻能帮到阿渊哥，糯米当即眼眸一亮，小拳头紧紧攥起，认真扬声道：
“好！糯米一定要快快变强！往后谁敢欺负阿渊哥，糯米就把他们全都咬死！”
话音刚落，糯米双眸隐隐泛起妖异红芒，一口小贝牙骤然变得尖利锋锐，宛若两排细密锯齿，周身亦悄然溢出一缕诡异煞气。
陈渊见状心头一紧，面露忧色。
陈擎苍亦是眸光微凝，抬手轻轻按在糯米肩头。
一股温和浑厚的力量，缓缓涌入她体内，瞬间抚平躁动的异种气息，令她恢复如常。
“乖，我等着小糯米修成大道，日后再来护我。”
陈渊揉了揉她的小脑袋，温声浅笑。
糯米重重点头，神色无比坚定。
“走吧小糯米，随爷爷前去修行。”
陈擎苍淡淡一笑，随手将一枚储物袋递到陈渊手中，随即牵着糯米转身离去。
陈渊握着手中沉甸甸的储物袋，再无半分杂念，当即迈步踏入静室，正式闭关冲击黄庭境。
“引周身法力汇入黄庭，凝聚本源、淬炼升华，令法力与神魂相融，踏入练气化神之境……”
“黄庭境的蜕变，不止是肉身速度与力量的暴涨，更在于神魂意识的强化。
届时可隔空取物，修为精深者，甚至能御使飞剑。”
“只是御使飞剑，对黄庭境修士而言终究太过勉强，实属鸡肋。
远不及紫府真人那般，御剑千里、取人首级于无形。”
content_en:
"Two months later, there will be the Family Assessment Conference."
Chen Yuan glanced at everyone in the audience, his expression calm and sharp, "I want you to take advantage of this period of time to practice hard and break through as many realms as possible. The more strength you have, the more confidence you will have to survive."
"At the same time, you must hone your own cultivation skills. When the conference starts, follow me to fight for more cultivation resources and qualifications for the Chen family."
Everyone looked at Chen Yuan with excitement.
It's rare in the world for a young master to be so considerate of his subordinates, and yet think about their lives and safety all the time!
For a time, everyone's hearts were full of gratitude, and many people's eyes were red.
"Okay, no need to be so pretentious, let's all go back to practice in seclusion."
Chen Yuan smiled faintly and waved his hand to signal everyone to step back and concentrate on practicing.
Chen Zhaoning knew that Chen Yuan was about to retreat and attack Huang Tingjing, so he did not want to disturb him any more and left gracefully.
She secretly made a vow to practice diligently and catch up with Chen Yuan as soon as possible.
Only Nuomi stayed in place obediently and never moved a step.
Chen Yuan told her softly that he was about to practice in seclusion and asked her to practice with Chen Zhaoning for the time being.
Before he finished speaking, Chen Qingcang walked over slowly and said bluntly that he wanted to take Nuomi to practice in person.
"Old man, you actually want to personally teach Nuomi how to practice?"
Chen Yuan's face was full of surprise.
There is a world of difference between whether one practices under the guidance of an expert or not.
The old man in front of him has unfathomable background, far beyond his own ability.
Having him teach Nuomi himself is naturally a hundred times more reliable than doing it himself.
"Yeah."
Chen Qingcang turned to look at Nuomi, with a rare gentle smile on his face.
"The evil spirit seeds in her body have already taken root and sprouted. I will tailor a practice method for her to help her completely control the original power of the alien species, and then find two supreme skills for her that fit her body."
"Brother A Yuan..."
Nuomi looked up at Chen Yuan, her little face full of reluctance.
Chen Yuan knelt down and comforted him softly:
"Practice obediently with grandpa. Only when Nuomi becomes strong enough can he truly help me and protect me in the future."
Hearing that he could help Brother A Yuan, Nuomi's eyes immediately lit up, her little fists clenched tightly, and she said seriously:
"Okay! Nuomi must become stronger quickly! Whoever dares to bully Brother A Yuan in the future, Nuomi will bite them all to death!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Nuomi's eyes glowed with a strange red light, her small teeth suddenly became sharp and sharp, like two rows of fine saw teeth, and a strange evil aura quietly leaked out from her whole body.
When Chen Yuan saw this, his heart tightened and his face showed worry.
Chen Qingcang's eyes narrowed slightly, and he raised his hand and gently pressed Nuomi's shoulder.
A gentle and powerful force slowly poured into her body, instantly soothing the restless alien aura and returning her to normal.
"Be good, I'll wait for Xiao Nuomi to build a great road and come back to protect me in the future."
Chen Yuan rubbed her little head and smiled warmly.
Nuomi nodded heavily, his expression extremely determined.
"Let's go, little Nuomi, follow Grandpa to practice."
Chen Qingcang smiled faintly, handed a storage bag to Chen Yuan's hand, then turned around and left with Nuomi in his hand.
Chen Yuan held the heavy storage bag in his hand. Without any distracting thoughts, he immediately stepped into the quiet room and formally retreated to enter the Huangting realm.
"Introduce the magic power from all over the body into the Huangting, condense the origin, refine and sublime, blend the magic power with the soul, and step into the realm of practicing Qi and transforming into a god..."
"The transformation of the Huangting realm is not only the surge in speed and strength of the physical body, but also the strengthening of the consciousness of the soul.
At that time, objects can be retrieved from the air, and those with advanced cultivation can even control flying swords. "
"It's just that the Flying Sword is too reluctant for Huang Ting Realm monks, and it is really useless.
Far from being like Master Zifu, who can wield a sword for thousands of miles and take people's heads invisible. "
